Pascual]] |blank1_name = Political party |blank1_info = {{Color box|{{party color|National Unity Party (Philippines)}}|border=darkgray}} [[National Unity Party (Philippines)|NUP]] |blank2_name = Congressional bloc |blank2_info = Majority }} '''Nueva Ecija's 4th congressional district''' is one of the four [[congressional districts of the Philippines]] in the province of [[Nueva Ecija]]. It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] since 1987.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 11, 2021}} The district consists of the city of [[Gapan]] and adjacent municipalities in southern Nueva Ecija, namely [[Cabiao]], [[General Tinio, Nueva Ecija|General Tinio]], [[Jaen, Nueva Ecija|Jaen]], [[Peñaranda, Nueva Ecija|Peñaranda]], [[San Antonio, Nueva Ecija|San Antonio]], [[San Isidro, Nueva Ecija|San Isidro]] and [[San Leonardo, Nueva Ecija|San Leonardo]].{{cite web|url=https://www.chanrobles.com/ordinance.htm |title=The 1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines |publisher=Chan Robles Virtual Law Library |accessdate=February 11, 2021}} It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Emerson Pascual|Emerson D. Pascual]] of the [[National Unity Party (Philippines)|National Unity Party]] (NUP).{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 11, 2021}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Congress ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
